scenarios.name: a settled bet is frozen: its owner can no longer edit the outcome or delete it

steps.sql: INSERT INTO app_bet_book__bets (id, title, status, outcome_summary, created_by, created_at, updated_at) VALUES ('b1', 'Rain by Friday', 'open', 'undecided', ?, '2026-01-01T00:00:00Z', '2026-01-01T00:00:00Z')
UPDATE app_bet_book__bets SET title = 'Rain by Saturday' WHERE id = 'b1'
SELECT title FROM app_bet_book__bets WHERE id = 'b1'
UPDATE app_bet_book__bets SET status = 'settled', resolved_at = '2026-01-05T00:00:00Z' WHERE id = 'b1'
UPDATE app_bet_book__bets SET outcome_summary = 'I won, obviously' WHERE id = 'b1'
SELECT outcome_summary FROM app_bet_book__bets WHERE id = 'b1'
DELETE FROM app_bet_book__bets WHERE id = 'b1'
SELECT id FROM app_bet_book__bets WHERE id = 'b1'

scenarios.name: once a bet is settled the losing side cannot rewrite, add to or erase the recorded winner, even as the bet's creator

steps.sql: INSERT INTO app_bet_book__bets (id, title, terms_type, status, resolved_at, created_by, created_at, updated_at) VALUES ('b1', 'Snow before December', 'money', 'settled', '2026-01-05T00:00:00Z', ?, '2026-01-01T00:00:00Z', '2026-01-05T00:00:00Z')

INSERT INTO app_bet_book__participants (id, bet_id, member_id, member_name, side_label, prediction, is_winner, created_by, created_at) VALUES ('p-win', 'b1', ?, 'Winner', 'yes', 'It will snow', 1, ?, '2026-01-01T00:00:00Z')

INSERT INTO app_bet_book__participants (id, bet_id, member_id, member_name, side_label, prediction, is_winner, created_by, created_at) VALUES ('p-lose', 'b1', ?, 'Loser', 'no', 'No snow', 0, ?, '2026-01-01T00:00:00Z')

DELETE FROM app_bet_book__settlement_winners WHERE id = 'w1'
INSERT INTO app_bet_book__settlement_winners (id, bet_id, participant_id, marked_by, created_at) VALUES ('w2', 'b1', 'p-lose', ?, '2026-01-06T00:00:00Z')
